abstract_sentences.text: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have recently gained significant attention due to their strong zero-shot capabilities and widespread real-world applications.

evidence.anchor: strong zero-shot capabilities and widespread real-world applications

abstract_sentences.text: Such models typically require a computationally costly pre-training on large-scale, carefully curated collections of real-world sequences.

evidence.anchor: computationally costly pre-training on large-scale, carefully curated collections

abstract_sentences.text: To allow for a sample-efficient pre-training of TSFMs, we propose CauKer, a novel algorithm designed to generate diverse, causally coherent synthetic time series with realistic trends, seasonality, and nonlinear interactions.

evidence.anchor: generate diverse, causally coherent synthetic time series

abstract_sentences.text: CauKer combines Gaussian Process (GP) kernel composition with Structural Causal Models (SCM) to produce data for sample-efficient pre-training of state-of-the-art classification TSFMs having different architectures and following different pre-training approaches.

evidence.anchor: combines Gaussian Process (GP) kernel composition with Structural Causal Models (SCM)

abstract_sentences.text: Additionally, our experiments reveal that CauKer-generated datasets exhibit clear scaling laws for both dataset size (10K to 10M samples) and model capacity (1M to 783M parameters), unlike real-world datasets, which display irregular scaling behavior.

evidence.anchor: clear scaling laws for both dataset size and model capacity

abstract_sentences.text: The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/ShifengXIE/CauKer.

evidence.anchor: source code is publicly available
Time series data are ubiquitous in applications
comparable performance can be achieved by training them purely on synthetic data
meaningful correlations between samples and realistic temporal dependencies
synthetic data generation pipeline can be efficiently used
clear scaling laws both in terms of dataset size and model size
pre-training on solely synthetic data can lead to state-of-the-art performance

experimental_design.name: research questions
experimental_design.description: Q1 compares alternative synthetic generators; Q2 studies data/model scaling; Q3 asks whether CauKer can replace real-world pretraining benchmarks. No preregistered hypotheses or failure thresholds are given.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 分类时间序列预训练同时需要 temporal motifs 和可分的跨样本结构；CauKer 用 GP kernel/mean 生成 roots，再用 SCM DAG、随机线性聚合和非线性 activation 传播，在冻结 Mantis/MOMENT 上依次检验生成器、数据/模型/训练时间 scaling、sample efficiency 和跨域转移（p.3–10）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留问题与缺口、Figure 1 五步 pipeline、Q1–Q3、Table 1/2、Figure 2–7、关键 UCR 数字，以及 official checkpoints 含 UCR train split 的 OOD 说明（p.4–10）。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix B–N 放置 loss/architecture、Algorithm 1、36-kernel bank、敏感性、精确 scaling 表、domain/OOD、Chronos、embedding/attention、fine-tuning 和 clinical 结果；这些补足实现与扩展，但没有补出 causal proof、主结果不确定性或完整 seed/硬件 contract（p.15–29）。
final_judgment.best_pattern: Figure 1 把 GP temporal prior→SCM dependency→series 画成单一机制链；Table 1 按 SCM→FPFN→KernelSynth→Mean+KernelSynth→CauKer 逐级对照；Figure 3 与 Figure 7 分别把 scaling 和 corpus/size/OOD 信息压缩到可扫读对象（p.4、p.6、p.8–9）。
final_judgment.largest_gap: “causally coherent”是 DAG 生成语义，不是 intervention/causal-recovery 证据；scaling 只覆盖两种模型和 UCR/UEA；主分类结果多为无重复点估计且真实 baseline 暴露 UCR train split。Mantis 计数、WOODS wins、accuracy-drop 和 model-scaling wording 还存在印刷/版本冲突（p.3、p.8–10、p.16、p.24）。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 合成预训练研究应同时报告生成先验的组件贡献、数据隔离与基线暴露、数据/模型规模曲线、失败/敏感性对照，并给出聚合分母、重复层级和跨域异质性；这样 sample efficiency 才能和机制解释对应。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于 univariate/fixed-length TSFM pretraining 及类似生成数据研究；对 multivariate irregular、forecasting 或需要 causal guarantee 的任务，必须增加任务匹配的 OOD、结构和因果识别证据，不能由 CauKer DAG 直接外推（p.5、p.10、p.24–29）。
